templates.name: catena-coturn
templates.note:
A relay for voice and video calls. Calls in Nextcloud Talk and Element connect directly when the network allows it. From behind a network that blocks direct media, such as a hotel or an office firewall, they go through this relay. Adding it is optional: the applications that use it find it on their own. With it, Nextcloud Talk and Element calls also reach people on restrictive networks, and Nextcloud Talk gains its high-performance backend for larger calls.

Replaces A hosted TURN service.
